deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

hostnames.rationale: The hostnames served by the environment group — team-chosen DNS identifiers for routing. These are resource names/references with no generic secure value to enforce; requiring "at least one" is a functional, not security, requirement.

name.description: The resource ID of the environment group.
name.rationale: It sets the identifier of the environment group and does not have any direct security impact.

org_id.description:
The Apigee Organization associated with the Apigee environment group,
in the format 'organizations/{{org_name}}'.
org_id.rationale: It sets the organization association and does not have any direct security impact.
